title: React Native 0.87 - Strict TypeScript API, Metro Update, Swift Package Manager, AGP 9 Support
content:
React Native 0.87 Release Summary

React Native 0.87 has been released, introducing significant updates to improve stability, performance, and developer experience. Key highlights include the adoption of the Strict TypeScript API as the default, improved Metro performance, experimental Swift Package Manager support, and support for Android Gradle Plugin (AGP) 9.

Key Highlights

  • Strict TypeScript API: Now the default for all projects, providing more accurate, source-generated types and a stable public API surface.
  • Metro 0.87: Improved build performance with 2x faster source map generation and significantly reduced memory usage.
  • Experimental Swift Package Manager (SwiftPM): A new, optional alternative to CocoaPods for iOS, requiring no Ruby or Bundler.
  • Android Gradle Plugin (AGP) 9: Initial support provided for the latest version of the Android build system.

Breaking Changes & Toolchain Requirements

  • Minimum Requirements: Node.js >= 22.13.0, Kotlin 2.0+, and Android minCompileSdk 34.
  • Strict API: Deep imports into internal paths are now errors. Users can temporarily opt-out via tsconfig.json using the "react-native-legacy-deep-imports" condition.
  • API Removals: InteractionManager, specific deprecated props (Modal, StatusBar), and legacy native method mixins have been removed.

Related Resources Summary

  • Strict TypeScript API FAQ & Rationale: Details why manual types were replaced, the impact on library authors, and the move towards a stable JavaScript API.
  • SwiftPM RFC #0994: Outlines the design, implementation, and future migration plan for Swift Package Manager in React Native.
  • AGP 9 Adoption RFC #1006: Tracks the progress and compatibility requirements for integrating AGP 9 across the ecosystem.

For detailed migration instructions, developers are encouraged to use the React Native Upgrade Helper.
